name: Yogurt "Banana Split" with Strawberries & Peanuts
instructions: Roughly chop peanuts. Place on a plate.
Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice strawberries. Add to the plate with the peanuts, keeping them separate.
Peel bananas and halve lengthwise. Divide between plates or bowls.
Use an ice cream scoop or measuring cup to portion yogurt over the bananas, then top with sliced strawberries.
To serve, sprinkle "banana splits" with peanuts and enjoy!
author: Mealime
